verdict.rationale: Independent reviews show strong general application performance. TechPowerUp says it offers the best application performance, beating even the 9950X, and Tom's Hardware notes strong productivity performance. None of the evidence isolates single-thread results or ties them to the feel of everyday interactive work, so the 'leading single-thread' claim is only implied by aggregate scores. Missing for 10: explicit independent single-thread benchmark results (e.g., per-core scores versus competitors), evidence on interactive responsiveness or latency, and first-party single-thread performance data.

support.subject: As a power-user, everyday interactive work feels instant — leading single-thread performance shown in independent benchmarks, not just a peak-GHz number on a slide
